review: 255 actual original-avatar Unity images form continuous front, side and three-quarter 60 FPS previews. Inspected the loaded anticipation at frame25 and impact at frame38. At the unchanged 0.630-second contact, the right hand is 30.3 cm higher and the original diagonal shaft crosses at a higher elevation. The original free-arm counterbalance and hips/chest loading remain; no second-hand grip or locomotion lock was added. The smooth source-time derivative stays positive (>=0.848) and the native shaft's largest step is22.50 degrees at60 FPS. Source bind rig and original gameplay charge clip are retained.
limitations: Paired head contact, body-wood collision, support IK and normal-speed full-scene transitions still need verification. No final release or original gameplay-controller activation is claimed.
